screen_protocol.description: Per search, one deterministic DE/rand/1/bin run evaluates candidates at the gate p (tier-1 eligibility screen).

de_budget.evaluation_arithmetic: 20 (initial population) + 20 x 29 (offspring) = 600 evaluations per search, exactly the frozen screen cap

tier1_eligibility.criterion: entropy_converged at gate p: mean base-q check-message entropy < 0.01 for 20 consecutive iterations
tier1_eligibility.ineligible_handling: non-converged (or structurally invalid / NaN-Inf penalized) candidates receive sentinel maxima and are excluded from the gate screen; no threshold proxy is computed for them

refinement_selection.rule: only eligible candidates enter the threshold binary search; refinement candidates are the top 12 eligible candidates ranked by threshold proxy computed with the optimization seed (max), canonical (d0..d7, lambda0..lambda7) ascending tuple as tie-break

winner_selection.rule: search winner = refinement candidate with maximum threshold proxy (computed with the optimization seed); ties broken by canonical (d0..d7, lambda0..lambda7) ascending lexicographic tuple
winner_selection.no_closest_to_gate: Do NOT select a 'closest to gate' candidate from a failed search (design section 8)

validation_protocol.description: The winner of each search is validated on all 5 independent validation seeds (V10-20.4 uses the full validation_seeds list; >= 3 required).
validation_protocol.per_seed_procedure: full deterministic binary search with the refinement budget (n_samples=2000, max_iter=100, p_tol=0.002, p_lo=0.01, p_hi=0.49), one frozen seed per validation run
validation_protocol.conservative_threshold: min over the per-seed threshold proxies of the seeds used (all 5 for V10-20.4)

gate_reconstruction.rule: For each search, compare the search's conservative threshold (winner, min over per-seed validation thresholds) against the per-search gate.
